newsitem.title: UK: UK expresses "great respect" for new HK governor.
newsitem.headline: UK expresses "great respect" for new HK governor.

text.p: Britain on Wednesday welcomed the choice of shipping magnate Tung Chee-hwa as Hong Kong's new leader-in-waiting and said it had "great respect" for him.

A 400-strong selection committee, carefully assembled by Beijing, voted overwhelmingly as expected for the 59-year-old businessman to take over when the British colony reverts to Chinese rule next year.
Prime Minister John Major and Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind both sent messages of congratulation to Tung and said he was most welcome to visit Britain whenever he wanted.
"We have great respect for him. British ministers have every confidence he will be a worthy first chief executive of Hong Kong's special administrative region," a foreign office spokesman said.
